summary: Multi-environment SaaS features fully tested. All 4 features working correctly: (1) Environment switcher dropdown filters sites correctly, (2) GET /api/users returns all users for network admins, (3) Add Network Admin dialog has 'Select existing user' dropdown, (4) Environment admins dialog shows users and add functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: NetworkDashboard.js: Environment switcher correctly uses data-testid='env-switcher' and filters sites using filteredSites computed from selectedEnvId
NetworkAdminManager.js: 'Select existing user' dropdown correctly implemented with data-testid='select-existing-user', filters out users who are already admins
EnvironmentManager.js: Admins dialog fetches both admins and all users, shows user dropdown for adding new admins
users.py Lines 74-81: Correctly returns ALL users for network/system admins when no X-Main-Site-ID header present
main_sites.py Lines 110-128: Correctly enriches response with environment_id, environment_name, environment_color
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-environment features tested and verified: (1) Environment switcher in header shows All Environments/Production (9)/Staging (2), (2) GET /api/users returns all users for network admin without site context, (3) Network Admins 'Add' dialog has 'Select existing user' dropdown with 14 non-admin users, (4) Environment cards have 'Admins' button that opens dialog with user list and 'Select user...' dropdown to add admins. All features pass both backend API tests and frontend UI tests.

Environment Switcher Dropdown.details: data-testid='env-switcher' found in header, shows All Environments/Production (9)/Staging (2)

Environment Filtering.details: Clicking Production filters to 9 sites, Staging to 2 sites, All Environments to 11 sites

GET /api/users for Network Admin.details: Returns list of all users (14+) when called without X-Main-Site-ID header

Network Admin Select User Dropdown.details: data-testid='select-existing-user' dropdown in Add Network Admin dialog with 14 options

Environment Admins Dialog.details: Shows current admins and has 'Select user...' dropdown to add new admins
